items.title: 67619_Big Nick Nicholas oral history interview
items.q: And that's how I started with Dizzy.

ctx.x: Oh yeah, shoot,yeah. Shoot, I'd knew him in Chicago when I was with Tiny Bradshaw. He was workin' down in the Loop someplace and...but Ike was always a nice, nice person. He played piano and was a great tenor player. And, main thing, he was a nice human being. And we became friends. Yeah.
So Dizzy sent you a telegram; where was he at that time?
Well he told me to meet him in Detroit. I don't know where they were out on the road, but I met the band in Detroit. Yeah. In a theater. And that's how I started with Dizzy.
